verses.text: By David. LORD, I'm calling to you. You're my rock. Please don't go quiet on me, or I'll be like the people going down into the pit.
Hear me pleading when I cry out to you and lift my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
Don't drag me away with the wicked, with people who talk peace to their neighbors while plotting harm in their hearts.
Pay them back for what they've done and for how wickedly they've acted. Give them back what their own hands have earned.
They pay no attention to the LORD's works or to what his hands have made. He'll tear them down and won't build them back up.
Bless the LORD! He heard me pleading for help.
The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart trusted him, and he came through for me. My heart is full of joy, and I'll thank him with a song. 🎶
The LORD is his people's strength, a fortress of safety for his anointed.
Save your people and bless those who belong to you. Be their shepherd and carry them forever.
